methods.name: GDCLD-SegFormer
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation model based on the SegFormer transformer architecture, which uses a hierarchical transformer encoder to capture multi-scale contextual information and a lightweight multi-layer perceptron decoder for landslide identification.
methods.verbatim: The code used to produce data described in this paper as well as to create figures and tables can be accessed at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13956757 (Fang, 2024).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory (GDCLD) is linked and publicly available via Zenodo, and other input datasets are accessible through their respective providers. The custom code for the GDCLD-SegFormer model is provided via a persistent Zenodo repository link.
